about: The key profile of devices/apps/key (types/0x0010-key-input.md), modes CLICK and MULTICLICK. Invert is on, so a HIGH pin is a released key. DebounceTime 15 ms, HoldThreshold 500, HoldTickInterval 200, MultiClickWindow 350, MaxClicks 3. Down and Up belong to RAW alone (key_raw.json): here a press says nothing until it is released or becomes a hold. Every event carries the endpoint's own sequence number first.

steps.note: the press is settled, and CLICK says nothing about it — no Down
Click x1 on release, and nothing else — no Up
HoldTick with the time held so far
a hold is not a click, and the release is ONE event: HoldEnd, no Up, no Click
no Click yet — the window is open
the window closes 350 ms after the last release: Click x2
MaxClicks reached: Click x3 at once, without waiting for the window
and nothing when the window would have closed
a click, then press and hold
the window would have closed by now, but the key is down
HoldEnd alone; the click before it is gone
no late Click from the cancelled sequence
